Q00226_TestOfTheHealer/30658-07.html.text: Father Gupu: I don't know... I have no idea what's going on. Why don't you ask the Elves from Gludio Castle? I think they said they were from the Town of Gludio... And one of them was named Sorius.

Q00226_TestOfTheHealer/30658-02.html.text: Father Gupu: Really? Are you really going to make a donation? Sob...! Thank you! I gladly accept! Children, say thank you... Wait, Windy is missing! I'm sorry, but could you please look for a little girl? She often goes to play in the Wastelands ... She looks like... There should be a picture somew…

Q00226_TestOfTheHealer/30658-03.html.text: Father Gupu: No no, its all right. I wasn't expecting anything from you.

Q00226_TestOfTheHealer/30658-05.html.text: Father Gupu: No no, I can tell by your clothes that you can't afford to give a donation. Forget about it...!
